title.narrative: Decreasing TB burden in Sudan and reduce the number of TB deaths - Sudan (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Sudan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Sudan)This program has the following goals: To reduce the number of TB deaths by 75% in 2025 compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To increase the number of notified new TB episodes to at least 24,250 by 2025 and to increase TB treatment success rate to at least 90% from 2021 onwards. To increase the detection of MDR/RR-TB from 172 cases in 2018 to 755 by 2025 and their treatment success rate to at least 85% from 2021 onwards. To increase HIV testing in notified TB cases from 34% in 2018 to at least 95% by 2025 onwards and to treat every year 100% of identified TB/HIV with ARVs. To strengthen TB infection control in health facilities and to scale up identification and treatment of TB infection;. To strengthen the governance and the programmatic management capacities of Sudan National Tuberculosis Programme
